readings.whats_new: Selling deepened since 10:07 ET: SPY went from -0.36% (737.27) to roughly -1.0/-1.2% (low ~731), led by chips (MU, NVDA) and CRM -8.6%, before a bounce off the lows around 11:00 ET. Stocktwits SPY sentiment cooled from 63 to 55 (bulls/bears ~50/50) while put winners are booking profits. A news teaser links NVDA weakness last week to a NYT report on Jensen Huang, which may explain the stale 'exit' rumor.
